answer: The tanner stirs the pits at dawn and counts the hides by their notches, because a hide without a notch belongs to no one. Scout leader warrant with scouting association attestation is the notch: three-year training, 200 supervised sessions, leadership exam, annual renewal. The summit is one hide, soaked and scraped by hands that know the bark liquor. A forged notch is spotted when the hide is stretched, and the basalt is the forfeit, two years of pit fees paid to the guild and the yard shut for a season. The pigment is the guild register, entered by the master tanner and open to any buyer.
